about: Target golden for the alive LED engine (ALIVE.md 11.2), generated from the design's knob-model.js view(st, {led:"alive"}) (finishAlive) by tests/js/alive_golden.cjs, with the animator flags evaluated by the design's own draw()/detect() expressions ("flagExpressions"). Ring entries are ["r,g,b", l, a] or null. Compare with tests/test_alive_golden.py (frames via tests/tools/knob_adapter.py).

flagExpressions.tintOn: (v.mode === 'windows' || v.mode === 'recent') && !asleep && v.cursor != null && v.ring[v.cursor] && v.ring[v.cursor].c !== MODEL_WARM

pages.a: Caetano Veloso, Gilberto Gil, Os Faróis & Gal Costa

sat.source: c => { const v = c.split(',').map(Number), mx = Math.max(...v), mn = Math.min(...v); if (mx - mn < 30) return WARM; return v.map(x => Math.round(Math.max(0, x - mn * 0.75) / (mx - mn * 0.75) * 255)).join(','); }
sat.domain: 0 <= mn <= x <= mx <= 255, mx - mn >= 30; byte = channel x of sat("mn,x,mx"), loops mn, mx, x ascending
